review_notes: I read the whole file. I did not search the Mathlib, Batteries or core sources, so the reasoning rests on the file's own text. The new definitions are all private and local: `Good` (a coefficient order bound on polynomials over Laurent series), `jt`, `IsCuspK`, `FinBr`, and `swap` (a FibreModel that mixes the finite chart of one model with the infinity chart of another). All of them are tied to this project's `FibreModel`, `Place` and `modularFunctionFieldC` setup. I did not identify a Mathlib concept that is the same under the same assumptions, so I found no competing-concept case. `le_orderTop_sum` is a helper theorem, so it is standalone theorem duplication, which the rubric excludes. `jt` is an abbrev for the element `jqModC` of the subfield, and it only names that element. `FinBr` and `IsCuspK` are place predicates stated in terms of `Place.ord`, which the project defines. I found no evidence of a Mathlib version of either.
